## Purpose:

Where applicable, the purpose of this policy is to outline workplace flexibility at Relias, allowing staff to choose when they should work onsite or at a home office, unless an event is specified as mandatory for onsite presence. This allows employees flexibility to accommodate commutes, childcare requirements, and work/life balance, while still attending to the needs of the business and supporting our clients. All details contained in this policy are subject to role, business need and manager discretion, and can be changed at any time by Relias.

## Definitions:

Business Hours: Full-time Relias employees are expected to work a 40-hour work week; eight (8) hours per day. This does not include time taken for lunch, unless it is a working lunch.  The HQ location is open and staffed from 8:30 a.m. - 5:30 p.m. Monday - Friday, which is also designated as the acceptable window for meetings.

Flex Schedule: An alternate work arrangement outside of the standard business hours that consists of fixed start and departure times with the same number of hours worked each day (e.g., 7:30 a.m.-4:30 p.m. or 9:00 a.m. 6:00 p.m.)

Flexible Location: Employees have the option to work from Morrisville HQ or from their home office based on their personal needs, unless it is mandated by a company leader or department manager to be onsite.

HQ Employees: Employees within 50 miles of our Morrisville, North Carolina headquarters have the option to work from Morrisville HQ or from their home office. This includes surrounding areas of Burlington, Siler City, Fayetteville, and Rocky Mount.

&gt;50 Mile Employees: Employees outside of the 50-mile radius of our Morrisville, North Carolina headquarters, but who live within the state of North Carolina.  Cities included in this range include, but are not limited to: Alexandria, Asheboro, Asheville, Avon, Bailey, Boone, Brevard, Charlotte, Concord, Davidson, Denver, Gastonia, Greensboro, Greenville, Grifton, Hampstead, Henrico, High Point, Holly Ridge, Jacksonville, Kernersville, Lake Toxaway, Leland, Lexington, Littleton, Lumberton, Matthews, McLeansville, Merry Hill, Mint Hill, Monroe, Morganton, New Bern, Newport, Ocean Isle Beach, Rutherfordton, Salisbury, Shawboro, Spruce Pine, Statesville, Wilmington, Winston-Salem, Walkertown, Wintersville, Yanceyville.

Remote Employees:   Remote employees are defined as employees that work outside of the state of North Carolina.  Remote status is determined at the time of offer or after an approved request for relocation.

Lunch / Lunch Period: For the purposes of this policy, a lunch is defined as a one (1) hour break in a 9-hour workday. Lunches may be 30 minutes. A lunch period is strongly encouraged for all employees working a full day to allow for a mental health break mid-day.

## Policy Details:

- This policy applies to all employees within Relias working in North America.  Relias Germany has a separate policy.
- Employees may start their workday any time between 7 a.m. and 9 a.m. with manager approval.
- Employees may perform work onsite at our HQ location or from their home office depending on personal need unless it is mandated by a company leader or department manager to be onsite for specific meetings, trainings, or events.  The following requirements are applicable to the following groups of employees:
- o HQ Employees
-  Managers and above: 40 days onsite per quarter; duration at their discretion
-  Individual Contributors: 30 days onsite per quarter; duration at their discretion
- o &gt;50 Mile Employees
-  VP+: 8 days per month minimum
-  Directors: 5 days per month minimum
-  Managers: 5 days per month minimum
-  Individual Contributors: 1x per quarter ideally with minimum of 1x per year; duration at their discretion
- o Remote Employees
-  VP+: 8 visits onsite per year; duration at their discretion
-  Directors: 4 visits onsite per year; duration at their discretion
-  Managers: 2 visits onsite per year; duration at their discretion
-  Individual Contributors: 1 visit minimum; duration at their discretion
- Expectations for accountability, performance, and deadlines will not change as a result of this policy, although we do expect HQ employees to contribute to community building onsite at headquarters.
- An  employee  may  be  asked  to  work  hours  outside  of  their  requested  flexible  schedule  in  special circumstance, to attend required meetings, or to support department need.
- Working from home is not an alternative to childcare; parents with children at home are expected to have daily childcare during regular business hours.

## Exception for Essential Staff and Shift Workers:

Some roles within Relias, including our HelpDesk and Facilities functions, may be unable to participate in flexible work hours, and may be required to be onsite or work specific hours during the workday. Those in impacted roles will be notified as part of the hiring process or with advanced notice if they will be expected to be onsite on specific or every workday(s). The following factors will be considered for essential staff when a department determines whether ongoing flexible work can be accommodated:

- Operational needs of the department
- Impact on clients/potential clients/employees
- Ability to maintain peak staffing levels
- Whether  the  requirements  of  the  position  can  reasonably  be  completed  during  the  requested hours/location
- Whether the employee's results/productivity can be measured effectively
- Other factors specific to the department and/or role

![Image](data:image/png;base64,)

## Non-Exempt Employees:

Non-exempt employees are required to adhere to guidelines included in the Time &amp; Attendance policy.  The existence of a flexible schedule or adoption of core hours does not negate the necessity to clock all time worked, including clocking out for lunch.

## Remote Employees:

Remote employees are covered under this policy, including the exceptions noted above. Remote employees are expected to be available during the agreed upon hours for their role.

## Coordination with PTO, Sick Leave, Leave of Absence:

Existing Flexible PTO and Sick PTO policies are not altered by the existence of this policy.  Flexible PTO must still be taken in half-day or full-day increments, and sick PTO must be taken in two (2) hour increments. A full day of PTO for full time employees constitutes eight (8) hours.

The same methodology applies to other leave types including mental health days, calculation of short term and long term disability, and FMLA.

## Lunch Periods:

Lunch periods lasting a minimum of 30 minutes and maximum of 1 hour are strongly encouraged for those working regular business hours or a flexible schedule.  Employees should factor a lunch break into their hours of work when discussing requests for flexibility with their managers.  Example work days including a lunch are as follows:

- Flex schedule of 7:00 a.m.- 4:00 p.m. with a one (1) hour lunch
- Flex schedule of 8:00 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. with a 30-minute lunch

## Responsibilities:

Employees: If applicable, employees are expected to discuss their requested hours of work with their manager. Employees may also determine the best working location (HQ or home office) for them.  Work location, unless otherwise specified, does not need to be approved by management.

Managers : Managers should review employee requests for a 5-day flexible work schedule and approve or deny based on current business needs.  If questions arise, consult with your department head or Human Resources. Managers should provide timely notice if expectations for work hours or the need for onsite work is necessary.

Human Resources:   HR will provide consultation and guidance to managers regarding application of this policy.
